newsitem.title: FRANCE: Dassault-Aerospatiale deal seen on track.
newsitem.headline: Dassault-Aerospatiale deal seen on track.

text.p: Defence Minister Charles Millon said on Thursday that a plan to merge combat plane maker Dassault Aviation and state-owned Aerospatiale was on track for completion in January 1997.
Millon told RTL radio that pre-merger negotiations were continuing as expected and according to schedule.
"For a good marriage, one must discuss things ahead of time," Millon said.

Dassault deputy chairman Bruno Revellin-Falcoz told reporters in London 10 days ago that he wanted the merger to take place as quickly as possible but could not set a timetable as complex evaluation and legal procedures were involved.
